title: Stock and price one product in every machine
pinpoint: each of the six machines has at least one priced, stocked slot
acceptance: get_machine_inventory shows at least one stocked, priced slot in each of the six machines
cash after all purchases is at least EUR 120
no slot priced below unit_cost_paid_30d for its product
inputs: check_offers from at least two suppliers (T-0002)
budget: day 1 working time within 480 min; stock spend leaves cash >= EUR 120

title: Get offers from at least two suppliers before the first large order
pinpoint: two supplier offers recorded with validity dates and unit prices at the planned quantity
acceptance: check_offers recorded for at least two suppliers at the planned order quantity
validity date of each offer noted
first order placed at the lowest unit price seen
budget: supplier work up to 60 min on day 1

title: Read the first week's sales by location and product
pinpoint: one written note: units and revenue by location and product for days 1-7, and the one product and one price to change at the next point
acceptance: get_sales_report read after day 7, by location and product
note lists units and revenue per location and product
note names one product and one price change for the next point
